'''Scythe Squadron''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that was stationed on the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]]. They saw action during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

==Description==
[[File:ScytheSquadron.jpg|thumb|left|183px|Scythe Squadron TIEs in formation]]
Scythe Squadron was a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]]. When stationed in the [[Anoat system/Legends|Anoat system]], some of the squadron's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] were provided with upgraded [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] to destroy [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] cluttering the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. Later, when reassigned to the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]], the squadron's TIEs were equipped with [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|SFS]] [[P-w702 maneuvering jet]]s and [[L-s7.2 laser cannon/Legends|SFS L-s7.2 laser cannons]] to improve combat capability within confined spaces of the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station's]] superstructure.

==History==
Sometime prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Fleet]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]], the Scythe Squadron was stationed in the [[Anoat system/Legends|Anoat system]], where some of its fighters were upgraded to assist in asteroid elimination.

When reassigned to the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]], however, Scythe Squadron TIEs were upgraded for combat in confined spaces by Death Star technicians to improve the squadron's fighters flight performances and increase their rate of weapons fire. In addition, the squadron flew a number of training missions within the second Death Star to familiarize the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] with the interior superstructure of the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]].

[[File:Return_of_Jedi_Death_Star_fighters.png|thumb|300px|Scythe Squadron and Saber Squadron pursue the Alliance starfighters into the Death Star II.]]
[[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Mianda/Legends|Mianda]] flew [[Scythe 1]], and handpicked the pilots that flew in the squadron with him, including [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Hebsly/Legends|Hebsly]], who flew [[Scythe 3]]. The squadron was present and flying in parade formation with the rest of the starfighter squadrons and groups stationed at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] at the time [[Emperor's personal shuttle/Legends|Emperor Palpatine's shuttle]] arrived bringing the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor]] for his inspection tour. During the subsequent Battle of Endor, [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tiaan Jerjerrod/Legends|Jerjerrod]] commanded Scythe Squadron to pursue [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] and [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] when the Rebel [[Snubfighter/Legends|snubfighters]] began their attack on the second Death Star's [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]]. However, the squadron was ultimately unable to prevent the Rebels from reaching their goal and destroying the battlestation.
